name: HiVenues
summary: HiVenues has moved far beyond the prior parked PM4 snapshot. The independent Fable and GPT-6 Astra greenfield builds were frozen and blind-adjudicated, Candidate C synthesis was chartered from their strongest independent discoveries plus the mature substrate, and Candidate C Phase 2A is canonically accepted on main with ACCEPT / H1_CONTINUE. Issue #258 now governs bounded Phase 2B production-substrate and expressive-breadth work.
accepted_results: Candidate C charter records GREENFIELD_A = CLAUDE_FABLE_5_1 / FROZEN and GREENFIELD_B = GPT_6_ASTRA / FROZEN, with model identities revealed only after blind adjudication; the prior Astra quarantine objective is therefore satisfied.

Candidate C doctrine is host-first: the host's world becomes the interface to Hive, one canonical host graph supports many faithful projections, and metaphor is permitted at the experience layer while consequence semantics remain truthful.
Phase 2A was accepted at exact head c677e2faf59fe23b3383ef54e72619d6ab677c63, tree 677ea895205fbd360ae37a2169c8e2968575cc4a, and merged as canonical main bf9a0b4e61d57eed6bb5a81504d6e030f8b6ff7c.
Phase 2A acceptance is ACCEPT / H1_CONTINUE: a server/HTML-owned durable-state default remains viable, with custom client code limited to transient interaction state in the accepted slice.

Phase 2A preserves the hard boundary: no live-host migration, Hive write, signing, payment effect, provider mutation, external media upload, production deployment, or DNS/VPS effect was authorized by the merge.
open_questions: Can Phase 2B replace process-local canonical persistence with durable restart-safe/concurrency-safe workspace and immutable Release persistence without browser-mirrored canonical state?
Can the Media plane gain durable identity/provenance and real admitted assets while preserving truthful provider and external-effect boundaries?
Can a third genuinely structural composition prove frontend-factory breadth rather than theme-level variation?
Can Studio deepen Look / Voice / Connect / Activity capability without losing calmness or forcing durable state into custom client islands?
Can the dependency-closed urgent website-release path publish a live-base cancellation/status change without leaking unrelated draft work?
Will the H1 architecture continue to survive Phase 2B stress, require a narrow hybrid, or be falsified for a subsystem?
next_triggers: Execute Issue #258 / Candidate C Phase 2B on branch candidate-c/phase2b-production-substrate, which currently starts exactly at canonical main bf9a0b4e61d57eed6bb5a81504d6e030f8b6ff7c.
Any later live-host migration or external Hive/provider/payment/signing/deployment/DNS/VPS effect requires a separately qualified and authorized operation; Phase 2B does not authorize it.
superseded_material: The prior Observatory state FROZEN pending Astra credits/handoff is superseded: both independent greenfield results were frozen and blind-adjudicated before Candidate C synthesis.

The prior HiVenues current-state focus on open Issue #199 and pre-convergence PM4 work is superseded as current routing by the Candidate C synthesis/implementation program, while historical PM4 evidence remains preserved in repository history.
The prior canonical HiVenues commit 9351655112a25fd8a1d115d8c402534726b1e035 is superseded for current-state reconstruction by bf9a0b4e61d57eed6bb5a81504d6e030f8b6ff7c.
notes: ACTIVE reflects an explicitly opened bounded implementation phase, not permission for production/external effects. The Phase 2B branch existed at observation time and still pointed exactly to the Phase 2A canonical baseline; no Phase 2B implementation commit or PR was yet observable through GitHub at this pass.
